description: UA-DAM-Clim: a climate-enriched hourly dataset and reproducible pipeline for day-ahead electricity price forecasting in Ukraine is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Vladyslav Titov (National Technical University of Ukraine "Igor Sikorsky Kyiv Polytechnic Institute"). A reproducible hourly dataset (population-weighted Open-Meteo ERA5 climate, calendar, operating regimes, price lags and the price_spike classification label) for day-ahead forecasting of the Ukrainian day-ahead market price. Raw market series are not redistributed (reproduced by scripts under the source Terms of Use). Companion methods/software will be published separately. Coverage: national (UA); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
